title: Show constant-density local faults can defeat polynomial Gibbs-excess comparison
statement: For pi=Bernoulli(q)^N, fixed0<q<1/2, independent allowed X faults p in(0,1/2) give mu=Bernoulli(q_prime)^N, q_prime=q+p(1-2q)>q. With a=(q+q_prime)/2, delta_M>=1-exp[-N D(a||q_prime)]-M exp[-N D(a||q)], so delta_M->1 whenever log M=o(N).
